title: Umhlatshelo Wamukelwa Ngesihe
intro: Vala amehlo akho bese ubona ngeso lengqondo isigodi esikhulu nesithule lapho ukholo luvivinywa khona kuze kube sekupheleni. Usuzohlangana nomuntu okuzithoba kwakhe okuzolile lapho ebhekene nomyalo ongacabangeki kwaguqula umzuzu wokulingwa kwaba uphawu lwaphakade lokulalela nesihe saphezulu.
clues: Ngikhunjulwa eQuran phakathi kwalabo ababekezela ngokubekezela.
Ngangiphakathi kombono owawuvivinya ukuzithoba emyalweni ka-Allah.
Lapho ngitshelwa ngombono, ngathi ngenze njengoba ngiyaliwe futhi uzongithola ngiphakathi kwesiguli.
Ngangibekwe phansi ukuze nginikele ngomhlatshelo, kodwa u-Allah wamemezela ukuthi umbono usugcwalisekile.
UNkulunkulu wangihlenga ngomhlatshelo omkhulu, wangishiyela udumo phakathi kwezizukulwane ezizayo.
Ngingu-Ismail, owaphakamisa izisekelo zeNdlu Engcwele no-Ibrahim, okukhulunywa ngaye kanye no-Idris noDhul-Kifl phakathi kwabalungile.

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Ushaywe ukuqhuma okukhulu ngenxa yokwenqaba ikamela lensikazi
